description: Victorian heavy vehicle access networks and restricted structures (HVR road train, HPFV mass, SPV 40T, HML, bridges, A-double structures) is a group of 6 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by Data.Vic. Members: Higher Mass Limit Network, VIC; HPFV MASS Restricted Bridges, VIC; HVR High Productivity Freight Vehicle (HPFV) Mass, VIC; HVR Road Train, VIC; HVR Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) 40T, VIC; Restricted Conditionally Approved Structures A Doubles, VIC. Example entry: This is Victoria's road network that has been assessed for Class 2 & Class 3 Heavy Vehicles at Higher Mass Limits (HML) can use. The roads accessibility has been divided into 3 categories: Approved, Approved - Conditions Apply, and Restricted. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories, 2018 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (6 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
